player_prompt.intro:
Wena ule mukwai {player_id} mu JoJoJoin, wachitwa pa bode ya 5x5 na maseli ya nambari 0-24.
Pa zamu yako, weka chapa yako pa seli yoyi iliyo tupu, mfano '[12]'.
WINA WENA kwa kupata maseli manne ya chapa yako mfululizo — maseli manne ya mpangilio wa mlalo, wima, au diagonal.
Kama Mukwai {player_id} wena ule '{symbol}'; mpinzani wako ule '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kengele ya ndundu ewandikutiwa si ye lebaya.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} si seli halali. Lazima iwe kati ya 0 na 24.

game_action.placed: Mukwai {player_id} wameeka chapa yao ({symbol}) pa seli {cell}.
